name: E2j — Graph Viewer (Single-File Local UI)
description: Interactive knowledge-graph viewer served at GET /graph/{collection}/view as one self-contained HTML page with inlined force-layout library, embedded token, node search, click-to-inspect panel and truncation banner.
effort: Mostly one large front-end HTML resource with an inlined library, plus one route, one additive response field and an auth middleware exception for query-string tokens. Security of token exposure and offline-only constraint are the risky parts. Manual browser testing needed.
